import "fmt"

examples.titleEn: Read a List of Numbers and Compute Average
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة عدد n ثم n من الأعداد، وحساب متوسطها باستخدام حلقة.
examples.descEn: Learn to read an integer n followed by n numbers, and compute their average using a loop.
examples.code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var n int
	fmt.Scan(&n)

	sum := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		var x int
		fmt.Scan(&x)
		sum += x
	}

	avg := float64(sum) / float64(n)
	fmt.Printf("Average: %.2f\n", avg)
}

examples.titleEn: Read Two Numbers and Sum Them

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var x int = 7
	var y int = 2

}

examples.descEn: Learn how to declare variables of different types in Go and print their values.
examples.code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	// أنواع أساسية: عدد صحيح، عدد عشري، نص، منطقي
	var age int = 25
	var height float64 = 1.75
	var name string = "Sara"
	var isStudent bool = true

	fmt.Println("Name:", name)
	fmt.Println("Age:", age)
	fmt.Println("Height:", height)
	fmt.Println("Student:", isStudent)
}

Name: Sara
Age: 25
Height: 1.75
Student: true
